text: {"lessons":["A few months of gains and losses are noisy; I should not mistake short-term performance for evidence that my strategy is working or failing.","Treating each stock as a separate account can make me reluctant to sell losers; I should judge each holding by its future prospects and its role in my overall portfolio, not just its purchase price.","Rarely trading has spared me unnecessary reactions to volatility, but I should still review diversification and risk periodically rather than letting the portfolio drift unattended."]}
